title: 낙동강수계관리위원회규정 / queue:ARTICLE:5:0:00005:part:1/1
full_text:
Article 5 (Advice by Advisory Committee, etc.)
(1) The advisory committee shall advise the Committee on the following matters:
1. Matters concerning the Nakdong River Basin Management Fund operation plan formulated under Article 66 of the National Finance Act;
2. Matters concerning rates of water use charges under Article 32 of the Act.
(2) The Committee shall submit to the advisory committee the fund settlement report prepared under Article 73 of the National Finance Act no later than 120 days before commencement of the following fiscal year.
